Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
stories.summary: PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. GreenLight is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk diffs after safety checks, a risk score and an LLM review. OpenAI, Anthropic and Sonar describe similar ways to automate approval while keeping humans on risky changes.

stories.title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
stories.summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind.

stories.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
stories.summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops?

stories.title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
stories.summary: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations.

stories.title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos

stories.title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
stories.summary: Complexity theorist and former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson argues that AI's recent math breakthroughs matter far beyond academia. The possible consequences, he writes, range from reshaping the global economy to threatening all life on Earth. He's also "virtually certain" that AI labs are sitting on "one or more bombshells" in cryptography.

stories.title: GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error
stories.summary: OpenAI says a billing bug gave GPT-6.2 users incorrect discounts. After the fix, Astra and Sol users hit their limits 40 and 25 percent faster than last week. As an apology, subscribers get an extra reset, and business users get free Fast Mode through year-end. OpenAI is also testing a Chat and Work mode merger.
